paths.name: Repeated source admission
paths.observed_algorithm: Each selection resolves and reads the manifest and reads/hashes the complete source. The LRU caches the immutable image only after these operations.
paths.semantics_to_preserve: Warm selected source drift must remain visible; a timing hypothesis does not authorize skipping source checks.

paths.name: Reference requests and observations
paths.observed_algorithm: Two original reference subprocesses receive the complete 256-case workload. Parent request and child result wire are selected independently. Parent qualifier counters do not include child counters.
paths.diagnostic: Time each original parent runner call and retain exact argv/env/request/stdout/stderr and existing wall_ns; no claim about uninstrumented child sub-stages.

paths.name: Measurement graph serialization
paths.observed_algorithm: After reference and native work, the measurements object includes combined observations plus both complete reference reports. It passes through ordinary selected wire; later store metadata/digests and receipt serialization use it again.

paths.name: Native wire continuation and scratch
paths.observed_algorithm: Each call creates output/workspace mmap-backed views and drives real HIA continuation requests. Actual step count and key-cache flag will be grouped by evaluate boundary.
paths.do_not_patch: ForeignGraphObserver methods, whose identities gate immutable-key caching.

diagnostic.runtime: local CPython 3.12.14, not a reproduction claim for historical GitHub 3.14.4
